scope: Normal AI/pending diplomatic replies; no process access or native calls

ai_reply_is_generated_during_execute.summary: After initial action settlement, command execute requires state0 and action+d0=true. It selects immediate AI evaluation only if game.control vector is nonempty, target slot DWORD is0, and target country2cd570 returns true. It clones, calls+b8, writes state1 or2, wraps and enqueues a reply command. This decision path contains no pause/date-arrival test and is not deferred to a daily AI update. The reply is another command, so this does not prove same-frame delivery or a paused command-pump contract.

normal_reply_mode.summary: Marriage+d0 returns the value byte; vassal+d0 returns state0 && value. Their+f0 method is the constant-false8f450, so the immediate AI branch normally calls+b8 rather than selecting its unconditional acceptance branch. False/cancel modes do not negotiate AI consent.

Preserve these native gates. The field names beyond their read predicate are not independently established. A false gate on the control-slot0 route returns without adding a human pending node.

Both contain a game+23a1/current-player override returning99999; it must not be enabled/used as a test shortcut. Legality does not imply AI acceptance. This report records score code and label evidence without replacing the complete native scoring formula.

reply_rechecks_rules_and_skips_initial_c.summary: Command gate skips the initial cooldown comparison when state!=0; it still invokes derived validity+80. Command execute also invokes derived validity+80 before effects. Thus accepted score only creates an accepted reply; changed legality can still prevent its effect. Never initialize a user request as state2 or bypass validity/cooldown.

It allocates an ID and stores current rawdate in+2c. AI immediate clones take the earlier route and can retain requestID0: a nonzero ID is not universal. Observe pending nodes by full handles/token/value/state/date/ID with bounded stable traversal.

That method destroys the action before marking node+18 if iteration is active; marked nodes can retain dangling action pointers. Skip marked nodes without dereferencing their action. Separate3607c0 prunes invalid/nonpending actions and3608d0 clears the whole list. None is rejection evidence.

three_day_ai_queue_expiry.summary: Country update2ee280 has a separate cleanup branch gated by game+7484!=0 and control-slot0. It copies action+2c, adds3*24 raw units throughcf4e0, and destroys/removes the node only when current rawdate is strictly greater. This branch does not write reply state1 or emit a rejection. Its full scheduler frequency is not established here.

accept_reject_notification_keys.summary: Marriage and vassal effect branches distinguish state2 acceptance from state1 rejection. For original actor matching the current player they resolve ROYMARACCEPT/ROYMARREJECT or VASALLACCEPT/VASALLREJECT and dispatch an8d4660 message through8c1b10. Recipient and third-party perspectives use WE/OTHER variants. Exact messages are positive evidence of reply-effect processing, but message absence is not a negative result.

Message moves1af350 preserve these identity fields. Standard message vtable is1c426e0; callback-owning history variant is1cc1ca0. No per-request ID is preserved in these identified fields; notification correlation is pair/type/date and new history-node observation, not exact request-ID proof.

message_history_readonly_path.summary: When server+1178 is nonnull, pinned server virtual+228=80e670 forwards to server+12d0 history manager1241af0. Its head+10/tail+18/count DWORD+20 list stores 28-byte nodes: message+0, shared-control+8, previous+10,next+18,removed BYTE+20. Insertion keeps the message alive through shared ownership and caps normal count at200 by removing oldest nodes. Do not invoke methods or alter shared-reference counts in an observer.

notification_filtering_limits.summary: 8c07b0 can drop presentation when observer/special player mode, missing server, handler+48=0, game+74e0=0 or settings lookup fails. History insertion additionally requires settings+11. Popup/pause settings+12/+13 are separate from history. Therefore a response can execute without visible or retained notification. The report does not change message settings.

limitations: No native functions called and no process accessed.
No paused command-pump scheduler proof or complete UI/AI scheduling reconstruction.
Message settings can suppress or evict history; missing nodes are never rejection evidence.
A new notification has pair/type/date correlation but no recovered exact request ID.
Full scoring formula is not reimplemented and no state/force/cheat fields are written.
